verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions for it. The evidence shows provider integrations (Gmail via Google OAuth, Outlook), self-hosting, and a cookie-authenticated MCP capability list, but nothing documents IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access or any mbox/EML export. Self-hosting and the MCP tools are adjacent features, not open-protocol reachability or standards-based export.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
